release_gates.requirement: The exact AECMOS v4 16 kHz ONNX weights with SHA-256 f53122f43cb7e5b77ec797e85c8b997cfc2aac8220857c709226d876de8c0a99, the model's own license terms, redistribution terms and written approval to execute; the repository MIT license covers code only.
The official AEC-Challenge AECMOS inference source pinned to one revision plus a pinned onnxruntime/librosa/numpy runtime approved for this task; an incidental environment is not a qualification.
A rights-cleared paired lpb/microphone/enhanced cohort with exact talk-type labels, alignment, device metadata and participant and redistribution rights.
Numerical parity for the 513/256/160 log-mel features, the 20-frame st/nst/dt markers, the 20-frame zero terminator, the zero GRU h0 state and both output names against the official implementation.
Official AECMOS echo and degradation predictions reproduced on the pinned runtime and rights-cleared cohort, keeping the two output dimensions separate.
A frozen paired aggregation with uncertainty intervals, retained failed items and a stated validity policy for every stratum.
Predicted scores labelled as learned AECMOS predictions and never as human ratings, plus authorized listening or an approved quality assessment where a rating is claimed.
Evidence-adapter intake, license and public-surface review, independent exact-head approval and explicit release admission before any developer exposure.
